name: software-development-team
description: End-to-end software delivery team — requirements, architecture, frontend, backend, QA, and DevOps, orchestrated by a delivery director for quality and pace.

displayDescription.en: End-to-end software delivery team — requirements, architecture, frontend, backend, testing, and DevOps, orchestrated by a delivery director for quality and pace.
displayDescription.zh: 端到端软件交付专家团，需求、架构、前后端、测试、运维六角色，由交付总监主理、把控节奏与质量。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好，我是软件开发专家团的交付总监齐活林。请描述你的项目想法或当前遇到的问题，我会判断该走哪条协作流程，并调度最合适的角色为你产出专业方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hi, I'm Qi Huolin, Delivery Director of the Software Development Team. Describe your project idea or problem, and I'll route the work to the right specialist.

quickPrompts.en: Hi, I'm Qi Huolin, Delivery Director of the Software Development Team. Describe your project idea or problem, and I'll route the work to the right specialist.
quickPrompts.zh: 你好，我是软件开发专家团的交付总监齐活林。请描述你的项目想法或当前遇到的问题，我会判断该走哪条协作流程，并调度最合适的角色为你产出专业方案。

quickPrompts.en: We're building [product/project] for [user group]. Please draft a complete PRD with user stories and acceptance criteria.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们打算做 [产品/项目]，目标用户是 [群体]，请帮我产出完整的需求文档（PRD）和验收标准。

quickPrompts.en: Our [system] is hitting [symptom] in production. Help me find the root cause and propose a fix plus prevention.
quickPrompts.zh: 线上 [系统名] 出现 [症状]，请帮我定位根因并给出修复与预防方案。
